![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Pass the `role` and `diagnostics` array to `indexRows` to enable proper structured validation and fail-closed behavior for all input files.

```suggestion
  const rows = buildRows({
    sourceRows,
    textByQuestionKey: indexRows(textRows, 'textHandoff', diagnostics),
    figureByQuestionKey: indexRows(figureRows, 'figureGate', diagnostics),
    evidenceByQuestionKey: indexRows(evidenceRows, 'evidenceOverlay', diagnostics),
    paths,
    generatedAt,
  });
```

No code change here. `compareRows` already routes string fields through `compareNatural`, which uses `Intl.Collator` with numeric ordering and null-safe normalization, and `compareNumberish` only subtracts values after both sides are finite numbers. That avoids byte-order string sorting and avoids `NaN` arithmetic for nullish/non-numeric values.
Fixed in 7da919bc6. The `textHandoff`, `figureGate`, and `evidenceOverlay` indexes now pass their role plus the shared diagnostics array into `indexRows`.

Fixed in 7da919bc6. Added `malformed joined input rows fail closed with diagnostics`, covering malformed/missing-`question_key` rows from `textHandoff`, `figureGate`, and `evidenceOverlay`; the focused test and full targeted suite pass.

Fixed in 7da919bc6. `indexRows` now accepts `role` and `diagnostics`, records `malformed_join_input_row` diagnostics for non-object rows or rows missing `question_key`, and skips those rows so the validator fails closed.
